question: My laptop won't connect to the VPN when I'm working from home
correctAnswerMustCover: Download/install the VPN client from the IT self-service page and sign in with institutional credentials
Approve the MFA prompt on your phone
A connect-then-disconnect pattern after a few seconds usually means an unapproved MFA prompt

question: How do I reset my password?
correctAnswerMustCover: Use 'Forgot password' on the sign-in page with your institutional email
The reset link is valid for 30 minutes
Password must be at least 12 characters with upper/lower case, a number and a symbol

question: I've been locked out after typing my password wrong too many times
correctAnswerMustCover: Locks after 10 failed attempts within 15 minutes and clears itself after 30 minutes
Sign out of all devices (a saved old password on a phone/tablet re-triggers the lock)
Raise an Account ticket only if it keeps relocking within minutes

question: How do I set up two-factor authentication on my account?
correctAnswerMustCover: Install Microsoft Authenticator and add it as a sign-in method via account security settings
Scan the QR code and approve the test notification
Register a backup method in case the phone is lost

question: I lost my student ID card, what should I do?
correctAnswerMustCover: Raise an Account ticket or visit the Help Desk immediately so the old card is deactivated
Replacement issued at the Help Desk with photo ID
First replacement each year is free; later ones carry a small fee

question: The wifi in the library keeps dropping out
correctAnswerMustCover: Move closer to the centre of the room / check if others nearby have the same issue
Laptop power-saving settings can turn off the wireless adapter on battery -- check Device Manager power management
If it persists across days/locations, raise a Network ticket with building, room, time and device details

question: My print job isn't coming out of the printer
correctAnswerMustCover: Check the printer's own display panel first for a jam/empty tray/toner warning
Clear the stalled print queue and cancel any Error/Deleting jobs, then send a test page
Confirm the correct printer was selected, not a previously-used default in another building

question: How do I top up my print credit?
correctAnswerMustCover: Top-ups are made online through the student portal
Balance is shown on the device screen after signing in, or on the self-service printing page
Credit can take up to 10 minutes to appear at the device

question: Can I install Microsoft Office on my own personal laptop?
correctAnswerMustCover: Yes, Microsoft 365 is included, covering up to 5 computers and 5 mobile devices
Install from the Microsoft 365 portal and sign in with your institutional account so the licence activates
Uninstall any existing personal Office copy first to avoid activation conflicts

question: I think I received a phishing email, what should I do?
correctAnswerMustCover: Do not click links or reply; use the Report button in Outlook
IT will never ask for your password by email
If you already clicked/entered details, change your password immediately and raise an urgent Account ticket

question: My OneDrive files aren't syncing anymore
correctAnswerMustCover: Check the cloud icon status (red cross = stopped, pause symbol = paused) and read the message it gives
Confirm you're still signed in and that you haven't run out of storage quota
Quit and reopen OneDrive to restart the sync before trying a full sign-out

question: How long should it take for my ticket to get sorted out?
correctAnswerMustCover: Response targets depend on priority: Critical 4h, High 8h, Medium 24h, Low 72h, Trivial 120h
Targets are measured to resolution, not first response
Priority is set by impact, not by how urgently the ticket is worded
